resources.string: This device does not support a step counter sensor.
Physical Activity permission is required to track steps!
Notification permission is required to track steps and display live progress!
To accurately track your daily steps in real-time, this app requires physical activity recognition permission. Tap OK to grant this permission.
To display your live step progress in real-time and maintain background tracking, please allow notifications.
Physical Activity permission has been denied. Please enable it in App Settings to track your steps.
Notification permission has been denied. Please enable it in App Settings to display step notifications.
To ensure step tracking continues reliably when the app is in the background or your screen is turned off, please allow the app to ignore battery optimizations.
%1$s requires to be enabled in \'Protected Apps\' to function properly.
